title: Arc B1 persistence identity, explicit replacement and autonomous headless acceptance

target_save_contract.name: development-only save v2
target_save_contract.equipment_reference: save-local index into the exact serialized inventory rows; optional item_id consistency check; no global UUID requirement

case_count_note: These planned cases are distinct from the 32 assertions in the original Arc A diagnostic evidence. Parametrized variants each require reported results.

classifications.required_b1: Every stated B1 invariant must pass with autonomous attributable evidence. No skip/xfail/manual substitution.
classifications.required_baseline_characterization: Execution and accurate comparison are mandatory. Report functional completion or an exact reproduced preexisting out-of-scope defect. This is not an unconditional repair gate for B2/B3/C/D/E/UI defects; new regressions and B1 defects still fail.

global_execution_contract: Use unique disposable fixture roots and actual installed dependencies; all real-loop tests use dummy SDL and process-local events, never full PC control.
Run all cases and every listed meaningful variant autonomously. The owner has no mandatory functional test task.
Choose explicit bounded subprocess, frame, turn and action budgets; timeout/crash/missing result/zero collection fail the harness.
Record exact argv, cwd, child environment choices, runtime/OS/dependency versions, imported-source hashes, fixture seed, run ID, phase, PID, expected/observed assertions and exit code.
Keep terminal writer save bytes immutable and give each reader/travel branch its own clone. Never call a mutated reader fixture the original checkpoint.
Separate actual-component/minimal-host, full-bootstrap/direct-method and original-real-loop evidence labels. Source review or screenshots alone do not prove functional completion.

Use source-grounded invariants and selected meaningful state, not an assertion that mirrors the implementation or a screenshot hash. Instrumentation may observe/schedule but cannot bypass the behavior being certified.

Fix all B1-scoped failures and newly introduced regressions. For a broader preexisting defect, reproduce it on baseline and candidate, preserve its exact signature and later-arc owner, and complete other independent routes.
Do not add a global identity framework, all-field save overhaul, atomic generations or user-save migration merely to make this matrix green.
Before accepting B1, review every required_b1 result and every characterization outcome. Do not convert a known-defect reproduction into a gameplay pass or use blanket xfail.
source_reference_convention: Paths refer to the reviewed project root; gameplay paths are relative to roguelike/. Function names are supplied because candidate line numbers will move.
